name: Borealis
description: Aurora curtains built from stacked warped sheets with vertical striations flowing through them, over a star field. Slower and more figurative than the existing aurora - this one has a horizon and a sky.

speed.description: Rate the curtains evolve and drift.

amount.description: How hard the sheets are warped. Low is a flat band, high is full curtain folding.

flow.description: Speed of the vertical striations running through the curtain.

stars.description: Star field brightness. The source's value barely registered once the sky gradient was tone mapped.

tint.description: Blend the cyan-to-indigo curtain toward the project palette.
